product.name: Linen washcloth, pair
product.description: Give it half a day at a wash house, and batch cedar drawer forty two stays with a flat mailer.

blocks.text: You will find linen cloths and not much else, packed Sunday evening as batch tin stall sixty eight.
The crew at the cutting table uses a cold rinse for this, and this one is batch harbor crate eighty one.
Hand hemming on Sunday evening is how the weaver still finishes these, batch hemp crock fifty five.

presentation.review_line: Read the lines, then pay if they still fit.

trick.evidence_text: Refill club: twenty six dollars and thirty nine cents on this order, then $26.39 every quarter.
trick.instruction: Choose the single-order line at $26.39 if you do not want Refill club at $26.39 every quarter.
